data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Pinnacle Holdings' most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in HWBK and SBFG.

On September 4, 2026, HWBK filed an 8-K Item 2.01 reporting completion of an acquisition or disposition of assets (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
